predecessors.name: French Fifth Republic
predecessors.text: French Dahomey, independent from France on 1 August 1960 as Dahomey; Cliopatria carries the land in its French Fifth Republic row for 1958-1960

ledger.x: 1 August 1960: Dahomey becomes independent from France.
30 November 1975: Dahomey is renamed Benin ('after the Bight of Benin'), and a self-described Marxist-Leninist People's Republic of Benin 'existed between 1975 and 1990'.
1 March 1990: the People's Republic of Benin becomes the Republic of Benin.

certainty.note: Judgment: the page lists neighbours (Togo, Nigeria, Burkina Faso, Niger) but no boundary instrument or dispute; the frontier is inherited from the French colonial delimitation, which the page does not describe.
